answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops a nebula of bulk fake identities. Each agent escrows 50 credits for one task slot; a jury of 5 peers checks the work, and fake or copied output burns the deposit. An honest agent pays once and recovers the fee from rewards, so its cost stays low and rewards are undiluted, instead of a spiral of repeated fees. An attacker cloning 1,000 slots must lock 50,000 credits, with no oasis left.
